Both patch package.json, pages/_app.tsx and pages/_document.tsx, and there can only be one frontend image. Outcome: one repo, one upstream pin (3.0.0 / 1755859a), one patch set, one image set, one Python CLI, two targets (laptop Compose, EKS Helm).
